verses.text: Blessed is the man who has not followed the counsel of the impious,
But his will is with the law of the Lord,
And he will be like a tree that has been planted beside running waters,
Not so the impious, not so.
Therefore, the impious will not prevail again in judgment,
For the Lord knows the way of the just.
Why have the Gentiles been seething,
The kings of the earth have stood up,
“Let us shatter their chains
He who dwells in heaven will ridicule them,
Then will he speak to them in his anger
Yet I have been appointed king by him over Zion,
The Lord has said to me: You are my son,
Ask of me and I will give to you: the Gentiles for your inheritance,
You will rule them with an iron rod,
And now, O kings, understand.
Serve the Lord in fear,
Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord might become angry,
Though his wrath can flare up in a short time,
A Psalm of David. When he fled from the face of his son, Absalom.
Lord, why have those who trouble me been multiplied?
Many say to my soul,
But you, Lord, are my supporter,
I have cried out to the Lord with my voice,
I have slept, and I have been stupefied.
I will not fear the thousands of people surrounding me.
For you have struck all those who oppose me without cause.
Salvation is of the Lord,
In parts according to verses. A Psalm of David.
When I called upon him, the God of my justice heeded me.
Sons of men, how long will you be dull in heart,
And know this: the Lord has made wondrous his holy one.
Be angry, and do not be willing to sin.
Offer the sacrifice of justice,
The light of your countenance, Lord, has been sealed upon us.
By the fruit of their grain, wine,
In peace itself, I will sleep and I will rest.
For you, O Lord, have established me singularly in hope.
Unto the end. For her who pursues the inheritance. A Psalm of David.
O Lord, listen closely to my words.
Attend to the voice of my prayer, my King and my God.
For to you, I will pray.
In the morning, I will stand before you, and I will see.
And the malicious will not dwell close to you,
You hate all who work iniquity.
But I am in the multitude of your mercy.
Lord, lead me in your justice. Because of my enemies,
For there is no truth in their mouth:
Their throat is an open sepulcher.
But let all those who hope in you rejoice.
For you will bless the just.
In parts according to verses. A Psalm of David. For the octave.
O Lord, do not rebuke me in your fury,
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak.
and my soul has been very troubled.
Turn to me, Lord, and rescue my soul.
For there is no one in death who would be mindful of you.
I have labored in my groaning.
My eye has been troubled by rage.
Scatter before me, all you who work iniquity,
The Lord has heard my supplication.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and together be greatly troubled.
A Psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord because of the words of Cush, the son of Jemini.
O Lord, my God, in you I have hoped.
lest at any time, like a lion,
O Lord, my God, if there is iniquity in my hands,
if I have repaid those who rendered evils to me,
let the enemy pursue my soul, and take hold of it,
Rise up, Lord, in your anger.
and a congregation of people will surround you.
The Lord judges the people.
The wickedness of sinners will be consumed,
Just is my help from the Lord,
God is a just judge, strong and patient.
Unless you will be converted, he will brandish his sword.
And with it, he has prepared instruments of death.
Behold him who has given birth to injustice:
He has opened a pit and enlarged it.
His sorrow will be turned upon his own head,
I will confess to the Lord according to his justice,
Unto the end. For the oil and wine presses. A Psalm of David.
O Lord, our Lord, how admirable is your name throughout all the earth!
Out of the mouths of babes and infants, you have perfected praise,
For I will behold your heavens, the works of your fingers:
What is man, that you are mindful of him,
You reduced him to a little less than the Angels;
and you have set him over the works of your hands.
You have subjected all things under his feet,
the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea,
O Lord, our Lord, how admirable is your name
Unto the end. For the secrets of the Son. A Psalm of David.
I will confess to you, Lord, with my whole heart.
I will rejoice and exult in you.
For my enemy will be turned back.
For you have accomplished my judgment and my cause.
You have rebuked the Gentiles,
The spears of the enemy have failed in the end,
But the Lord remains in eternity.
And he will judge the whole world in equity.
And the Lord has become a refuge for the poor,
And may they hope in you, who know your name.
Sing a psalm to the Lord, who dwells in Zion.
Because of those who yearned for their blood, he has remembered them.
Have mercy on me, Lord.
You lift me up from the gates of death,
I will exult in your salvation.
The Lord will be recognized when making judgments.
The sinners will be turned into Hell:
For the poor will not be forgotten in the end.
Rise up, Lord: do not let man be strengthened.
O Lord, establish a lawgiver over them,
So then, why, O Lord, have you withdrawn far away?
While the impious is arrogant, the poor is enflamed.
For the sinner is praised by the desires of his soul,
The sinner has provoked the Lord;
God is not before his sight. His ways are stained at all times.
For he has said in his heart, “I will not be disturbed:
His mouth is full of curses, and bitterness, and deceit.
He sits in ambush, with resources in hidden places,
His eyes catch sight of the poor.
With his snare, he will bring him down.
For he has said in his heart, “God has forgotten,
O Lord God, rise up.
How has the impious one provoked God?
You do see, for you examine hardship and sorrow,
Break the arm of the sinner and the malicious.
The Lord shall reign in eternity, even forever and ever.
The Lord has heeded the desire of the poor.
so as to judge for the orphan and the humble,
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
I trust in the Lord.
For behold, the sinners have bent their bow.
For they have destroyed the things that you have completed.
The Lord is in his holy temple.
The Lord questions the just and the impious.
He will rain down snares upon sinners.
For the Lord is just, and he has chosen justice.
Unto the end. For the octave. A Psalm of David.
Save me, O Lord, because holiness has passed away,
They have been speaking emptiness, each one to his neighbor;
May the Lord scatter all deceitful lips,
They have said: “We will magnify our tongue;
Because of the misery of the destitute and the groaning of the poor,
The eloquence of the Lord is pure eloquence,
You, O Lord, will preserve us, and you will guard us from this generation into eternity.
The impious wander aimlessly. According to your loftiness,
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
How long can I take counsel in my soul,
How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
Look upon me and listen to me, O Lord my God.
lest at any time my enemy may say, “I have prevailed against him.”
But I have hoped in your mercy.
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
The Lord has looked down from heaven upon the sons of men,
They have all gone astray; together they have become useless.Their throat is an open sepulcher.Their feet are swift to shed blood.There is no fear of God before their eyes.
Will they never learn:
They have not called upon the Lord.
For the Lord is with the just generation.
Who will grant the salvation of Israel from Zion?
A Psalm of David.
He who walks without blemish and who works justice.
He who speaks the truth in his heart,
In his sight, the malicious one has been reduced to nothing,
He who has not given his money in usury,
The inscription of a title: of David himself.
I have said to the Lord: “You are my God,
As for the saints, who are in his land:
Their infirmities have been multiplied;
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup.
The lots have fallen upon me with clarity.
I will bless the Lord, who has bestowed understanding upon me.
I have made provision for the Lord always in my sight.
Because of this, my heart has been joyful, and my tongue has exulted.
For you will not abandon my soul to Hell,
You have made known to me the ways of life;
A Prayer of David.
Let my judgment proceed from your presence.
You have tested my heart and visited it by night.
Therefore, may my mouth not speak the works of men.
Perfect my steps in your paths,
I have cried out because you,
Make your mercies wonderful, for you save those who hope in you.
From those who resist your right hand,
from the face of the impious who have afflicted me.
They have concealed their fatness;
They have cast me out, and now they have surrounded me.
They have taken me, like a lion ready for the prey,
Rise up, O Lord, arrive before him and displace him.
Lord, divide them from the few of the earth in their life.
But as for me, I will appear before your sight in justice.

Unto the end. For David, the servant of the Lord, who spoke the words of this canticle to the Lord, in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. And he said:
I will love you, O Lord my strength.
The Lord is my firmament, my refuge, and my liberator.
Praising, I will call upon the Lord.
The sorrows of death surrounded me,
The sorrows of Hell encompassed me,
In my tribulation, I called upon the Lord, and I cried out to my God.
The earth was shaken, and it trembled.
A smoke ascended by his wrath, and a fire flared up from his face:
He bent the heavens, and they descended.
And he ascended upon the cherubim, and he flew:
And he set darkness as his hiding place,
At the brightness that was before his sight,
And the Lord thundered from heaven,
And he sent forth his arrows and scattered them.
Then the fountains of waters appeared,
He sent from on high, and he accepted me.
He rescued me from my strongest enemies, and from those who hated me.
They intercepted me in the day of my affliction,
And he led me out, into a wide place.
And the Lord will reward me according to my justice,
For I have preserved the ways of the Lord,
For all his judgments are in my sight, and his justice,
And I will be immaculate together with him,
And the Lord will reward me according to my justice
With the holy, you will be holy,
and with the elect, you will be elect,
For you will save the humble people,
For you illuminate my lamp, O Lord.
For in you, I will be delivered from temptation;
As for my God, his way is undefiled.
For who is God, except the Lord?
It is God who has wrapped me with virtue
It is he who has perfected my feet, like the feet of deer,
It is he who trains my hands for battle.
And you have given me the protection of your salvation.
You have expanded my footsteps under me,
I will pursue my enemies and apprehend them.
I will break them, and they will not be able to stand.
And you have wrapped me with virtue for the battle.
And you have given the back of my enemies to me,
They cried out, but there was none to save them,
And I will crush them into dust before the face of the wind,
You will rescue me from the contradictions of the people.
A people I did not know has served me.
The sons of foreigners have been deceitful to me,
The Lord lives, and blessed is my God,
O God, who vindicates me and who subdues the people under me,
And you will exalt me above those who rise up against me.
Because of this, O Lord, I will confess to you among the nations,
magnifying the salvation of his king,
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
The heavens describe the glory of God,
Day proclaims the word to day,
There are no speeches or conversations,
Their sound has gone forth through all the earth,
He has placed his tabernacle in the sun,
his departure is from the summit of heaven.
The law of the Lord is immaculate, converting souls.
The justice of the Lord is right, rejoicing hearts.
The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for all generations.
desirable beyond gold and many precious stones,
For, indeed, your servant keeps them,
Who can understand transgression?
and from those of others, spare your servant.
And the eloquence of my mouth will be so as to please,
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
May the Lord hear you in the day of tribulation.
May he send you help from the sanctuary
May he be mindful of all your sacrifices,
May he grant to you according to your heart,
We will rejoice in your salvation,
May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
Some trust in chariots,
They have been bound,
O Lord, save the king,
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
In your virtue, Lord, the king will rejoice,
You have granted him the desire of his heart,
For you have gone ahead of him with blessings of sweetness.
He petitioned you for life, and you have granted him length of days,
Great is his glory in your salvation.
For you will give him as a blessing forever and ever.
Because the king hopes in the Lord,
May your hand be found by all your enemies.
You will make them like an oven of fire, in the time of your presence.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their offspring from the sons of men.
For they have turned evils upon you; they have devised plans,
For you will make them turn their back;
Be exalted, Lord, by your own power.
Unto the end. For the tasks of early morning. A Psalm of David.
O God, my God, look upon me.
My God, I will cry out by day,
But you dwell in holiness, O Praise of Israel.
In you, our fathers have hoped.
They cried out to you,
But I am a worm and not a man:
All those who saw me have derided me.
He has hoped in the Lord, let him rescue him.
For you are the one who has drawn me out of the womb,
I have been thrown upon you from the womb;
Do not depart from me. For tribulation is near,
Many calves have surrounded me;
They have opened their mouths over me,
And so, I have been poured out like water,
My strength has dried up like clay,
For many dogs have surrounded me.
They have numbered all my bones.
They divided my garments among them,
But you, O Lord, do not take your help far from me;
O God, rescue my soul from the spear,
Save me from the mouth of the lion,
I will declare your name to my brothers.
You who fear the Lord, praise him.
May all the offspring of Israel fear him.
My praise is with you, within a great church.
The poor will eat and be satisfied,
All the ends of the earth will remember,
For the kingdom belongs to the Lord,
All the fat of the earth have gnashed their teeth,
And my soul will live for him,
There will be announced for the Lord a future generation,
A Psalm of David.
He has settled me here, in a place of pasture.
He has converted my soul.
For, even if I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death,
You have prepared a table in my sight,
And your mercy will follow me all the days of my life,
For the First Sabbath. A Psalm of David.
For he has founded it upon the seas,
Who will ascend to the mountain of the Lord?
The innocent of hands and the clean of heart,
He will receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God, his Savior.
This is the generation that seeks him,
Lift up your gates, you princes,
Who is this King of Glory? The Lord who is strong and powerful; the Lord powerful in battle.
Lift up your gates, you princes,
Who is this King of Glory? The Lord of virtue.
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
In you, my God, I trust. Let me not be put to shame.
And do not let my enemies laugh at me.
May all those who act unjustly over nothing be confounded.
Direct me in your truth, and teach me.
O Lord, remember your compassion and your mercies, which are from ages past.
Do not remember the offenses of my youth and my ignorances.
The Lord is sweet and righteous. Because of this,
He will direct the mild in judgment.
All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth,
Because of your name, O Lord, you will pardon my sin, for it is great.
Which is the man who fears the Lord?
His soul will dwell upon good things,
The Lord is a firmament to those who fear him,
My eyes are ever toward the Lord,
Look upon me and have mercy on me; for I am alone and poor.
The troubles of my heart have been multiplied.
See my lowliness and my hardship, and release all my offenses.
Consider my enemies, for they have been multiplied,
Preserve my soul and rescue me. I will not be ashamed, for I have hoped in you.
The innocent and the righteous have adhered to me,
Free Israel, O God, from all his tribulations.
Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
Examine me, Lord, and test me:
For your mercy is before my eyes, and I am serene in your truth.
I have not sat with the council of emptiness,
I have hated the assembly of the malicious;
I will wash my hands among the innocent,
so that I may hear the voice of your praise and describe all your wonders.
O Lord, I have loved the beauty of your house and the dwelling place of your glory.
O God, do not let my soul perish with the impious,
in whose hands are iniquities: their right hand has been filled by bribes.
But as for me, I have been walking in my innocence.
My foot has stood firm in the straight path.
A Psalm of David, before he was sealed.
Meanwhile, the guilty draw near to me, so as to eat my flesh.
If entrenched armies were to stand together against me, my heart would not fear.
One thing I have asked of the Lord, this I will seek:
For he has hidden me in his tabernacle.
He has exalted me upon the rock, and now he has exalted my head above my enemies.
Hear my voice, O Lord, with which I have cried out to you.
My heart has spoken to you; my face has sought you.
Do not turn your face away from me.
For my father and my mother have left me behind, but the Lord has taken me up.
O Lord, establish a law for me in your way,
Do not surrender me to the souls of those who trouble me.
I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
Wait for the Lord, act manfully; and let your heart be strengthened, and remain with the Lord.
A Psalm of David himself.
Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to you,
Do not draw me away together with sinners;
Give to them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their inventions.
Since they have not understood the works of the Lord and the works of his hands,
Blessed is the Lord, for he has heard the voice of my supplication.
The Lord is my helper and my protector.
The Lord is the strength of his people and the protector of the salvation of his Christ.
O Lord, save your people and bless your inheritance,
A Psalm of David, at the completion of the tabernacle.
Bring to the Lord, glory and honor.
The voice of the Lord is over the waters.
The voice of the Lord is in virtue.
The voice of the Lord shatters the cedars.
And it will break them into pieces, like a calf of Lebanon,
The voice of the Lord cuts through the flame of fire.
The voice of the Lord shakes the desert.
The voice of the Lord is preparing the stags,
The Lord causes the great flood to dwell.
The Lord will give virtue to his people.
A Canticle Psalm. In dedication to the house of David.
I will extol you, Lord, for you have sustained me,
O Lord my God, I have cried out to you, and you have healed me.
Lord, you led my soul away from Hell.
Sing a psalm to the Lord, you his saints,
For wrath is in his indignation, and life is in his will.
But I have said in my abundance: “I will never be disturbed.”
O Lord, in your will, you made virtue preferable to beauty for me.
To you, Lord, I will cry out. And I will make supplication to my God.
What use would there be in my blood, if I descend into corruption?
The Lord has heard, and he has been merciful to me.
You have turned my mourning into gladness for me.
So then, may my glory sing to you, and may I not regret it.
Unto the end. A Psalm of David according to an ecstasy.
In you, Lord, I have hoped; let me never be confounded. In your justice, deliver me.
Incline your ear to me. Hasten to rescue me.
For you are my strength and my refuge;
You will lead me out of this snare,
Into your hands, I commend my spirit.
You have hated those who practice emptiness to no purpose. But I have hoped in the Lord.
I will exult and rejoice in your mercy.
And you have not enclosed me in the hands of the enemy.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am troubled.
For my life has fallen into sorrow, and my years into sighing.
I have become a disgrace among all my enemies,
I have become forgotten, like one dead to the heart.
For I have heard the harsh criticism of many who linger in the area.
But I have hoped in you, O Lord. I said, “You are my God.”
My fate is in your hands. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who are persecuting me.
Shine your face upon your servant. Save me in your mercy.
Do not let me be confounded, Lord, for I have called upon you.
May deceitful lips be silenced: those that speak iniquity against the just,
How great is the multitude of your sweetness, O Lord,
You hide them in the concealment of your face, from the disturbance of men.
Blessed is the Lord. For he has shown his wonderful mercy to me, in a fortified city.
But I said in the excess of my mind:
Love the Lord, all you his saints.
Act manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, all you who hope in the Lord.
The understanding of David himself.
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not imputed sin,
Because I was silent, my bones grew old,
For, day and night, your hand was heavy upon me.
I have acknowledged my offense to you,
For this, everyone who is holy will pray to you in due time.
You are my refuge from the tribulation that has surrounded me. You are my exultation:
I will give you understanding, and I will instruct you in this way,
Do not become like the horse and the mule, which have no understanding.
Many are the scourges of the sinner,
Rejoice in the Lord and exult, you just ones,
A Psalm of David.
Confess to the Lord with stringed instruments;
Sing to him a new song. Sing psalms to him skillfully, with loud exclamation.
For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are in faith.
He loves mercy and judgment. The earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.
By the word of the Lord, the heavens were established,
gathering together the waters of the sea, as if in a container,
Let all the earth fear the Lord, and may all the inhabitants of the world quake before him.
For he spoke, and they became. He commanded, and they were created.
The Lord scatters the counsels of the nations.
But the counsel of the Lord remains for eternity,
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord,
The Lord has looked down from heaven.
From his well-prepared dwelling place,
He has formed the hearts of each one of them;
The king is not saved by great power,
The horse is false safety; for he will not be saved by the abundance of his powers.
Behold, the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him and on those who hope in his mercy,
so as to rescue their souls from death and to feed them during famine.
Our soul remains with the Lord. For he is our helper and protector.
For in him, our heart will rejoice,
Let your mercy be upon us, O Lord, just as we have hoped in you.
To David, when he changed his appearance in the sight of Abimelech, and so he dismissed him, and he went away.
I will bless the Lord at all times.
In the Lord, my soul will be praised.
Magnify the Lord with me, and let us extol his name in itself.
I sought the Lord, and he heeded me,
Approach him and be enlightened, and your faces will not be confounded.
This poor one cried out, and the Lord heeded him,
The Angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear him, and he will rescue them.
Taste and see that the Lord is sweet.
Fear the Lord, all you his saints.
The rich have been needy and hungry,
Come forward, sons. Listen to me.
Which is the man who wills life, who chooses to see good days?
Prohibit your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil, and do good.
The eyes of the Lord are on the just,
But the countenance of the Lord is upon those who do evil,
The just cried out, and the Lord heard them,
The Lord is near to those who are troubled in heart,
Many are the afflictions of the just,
The Lord preserves all of their bones, not one of them shall be broken.
The death of a sinner is very harmful,
The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants,
Of David himself.
Take hold of weapons and a shield, and rise up in assistance to me.
Bring forth the spear, and close in on those who persecute me.
Let them be confounded and in awe, who pursue my soul.
May they become like dust before the face of the wind,
May their way become dark and slippery,
For, without cause, they have concealed their snare for me unto destruction.
Let the snare, of which he is ignorant, come upon him,
But my soul will exult in the Lord and delight over his salvation.
All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like you?”
Unfair witnesses have risen up, interrogating me about things of which I am ignorant.
They repaid me evil for good, to the deprivation of my soul.
But as for me, when they were harassing me, I was clothed with haircloth.
Like a neighbor, and like our brother, so did I please;
And they have been joyful against me, and they joined together.
They have been scattered, yet they were unremorseful. They have tested me.
Lord, when will you look down upon me?
I will confess to you in a great Church.
May those who are my unjust adversaries not be glad over me:
For indeed, they spoke peacefully to me;
And they opened their mouth wide over me.
You have seen, O Lord, do not be silent. Lord, do not depart from me.
Rise up and be attentive to my judgment, to my cause, my God and my Lord.
Judge me according to your justice, O Lord,
Do not let them say in their hearts, “Well, well, to our soul.”
Let them blush and be in awe together,
Let them exult and rejoice, who wish my justice, and let them ever say,
And so my tongue will express your justice: your praise all day long.
Unto the end. To the servant of the Lord, David himself.
The unjust one has said within himself that he would commit offenses.
For he has acted deceitfully in his sight,
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit.
He has been considering iniquity on his bed.
Lord, your mercy is in heaven, and your truth is even to the clouds.
Your justice is like the mountains of God.
How you have multiplied your mercy, O God!
They will be inebriated with the fruitfulness of your house,
For with you is the fountain of life;
Extend your mercy before those who know you,
May arrogant feet not approach me,
In that place, those who work iniquity have fallen.
A Psalm of David himself.
For they will quickly wither away like dry grass,
Hope in the Lord and do good, and dwell in the land,
Delight in the Lord, and he will grant to you the petitions of your heart.
Reveal your way to the Lord, and hope in him, and he will accomplish it.
And he will bring forth your justice like the light,
Be subject to the Lord and pray to him.
Cease from wrath and leave behind rage.
For those who are malicious will be exterminated.
Yet still a little while, and the sinner will not be.
But the meek shall inherit the earth,
The sinner will observe the just,
But the Lord will laugh at him:
The sinners have drawn the sword, they have bent their bow,
Let their sword enter into their own hearts, and let their bow be broken.
A little is better to the just than the many riches of sinners.
For the arms of sinners will be crushed, but the Lord confirms the just.
The Lord knows the days of the immaculate,
They will not be confounded in an evil time;
for sinners will perish.
The sinner will lend and not release,
For those who bless him will inherit the earth,
The steps of a man will be directed by the Lord, and he will choose his way.
When he falls, he will not be harmed,
I have been young, and now I am old;
He shows compassion and lends, all day long,
Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever and ever.
For the Lord loves judgment, and he will not abandon his saints.
But the just will inherit the earth,
The mouth of the just one will express wisdom,
The law of his God is in his heart,
The sinner considers the just one and seeks to put him to death.
But the Lord will not abandon him into his hands,
Wait for the Lord, and keep to his way.
I have seen the impious over-exalted,
And I passed by, and behold, he was not.
Keep to innocence, and gaze upon fairness:
But the unjust will be destroyed together:
But the salvation of the just is from the Lord,
And the Lord will help them and free them.
A Psalm of David, in commemoration of the Sabbath.
O Lord, do not rebuke me in your fury, nor chastise me in your wrath.
For your arrows have been driven into me,
There is no health in my flesh before the face of your wrath.
For my iniquities have walked over my head,
My sores have putrefied and been corrupted before the face of my foolishness.
I have become miserable, and I have been bent down, even to the end.
